# 02.02-atomic-upgrade: Upgrade and validate all projects together

## Objective
Retarget all solution projects together, update needed dependencies and consistent RSLLC assembly versions, address breaking changes and evaluate modern OpenAPI replacements with regression tests.

**Done when**: All required changes are implemented and solution build and applicable tests pass, with platform blockers documented.

## Research and scope inventory
- See the parent task and 02.01-compatibility-research for solution project graph, package and API assessment, SDK/workload checks and baseline build.
- Retarget the 25 solution projects and MAUI's four platform TFMs. Do not upgrade projects outside the active solution, per the user's explicit direction.
- The solution contains 19 production projects with explicit FileVersion, AssemblyVersion and Version values, initially 4.207.100. Set all three properties to the user-requested 4.208.110 in those 19 projects only. Six solution test projects have no explicit version set; do not introduce new version properties there. Validate XML values and build the solution after the metadata-only edit.
- Out-of-solution projects referencing net11.0 libraries may no longer build without their own upgrade; this is outside the chosen scope and must be disclosed. The temporary framework and package edits to those projects have been undone.
- Project-local packages include .NET 10 Microsoft.Extensions, ASP.NET OpenAPI and MAUI packages; upgrade compatible direct dependencies as appropriate after version discovery.
- Evaluate existing file upload and response OpenAPI transformers against equivalent framework APIs and exercise generated contracts; do not assume public document transformers are unused externally.
- Validate default solution build plus explicitly selected tests, including ApiCore tests not in the solution and MAUI platform targets where tooling permits. Review behavioral changes against documented triggers before claiming compatibility.

## Current validation and remaining work
- IDE solution build succeeds. Explicit Core tests: 783 passed; ApiCore tests: 24 passed; JsonStore tests: 20 passed; BlazorWasm tests: 2 passed.
- All four MAUI library target builds succeeded locally. The Razor SDK included appsettings as both Content and EmbeddedResource, producing Apple bundle-path warnings; the redundant Apple Content items were removed while retaining embedded settings. MSBuild item inspection and PE metadata confirm all three settings resources are embedded in both iOS and Mac Catalyst assemblies, and neither build now emits the bundle-path or unsupported-platform warnings. Library builds do not validate device deployment or Apple app packaging. Android minimum is API 24 (user approved); iOS minimum is 16.4 for MAUI Blazor and Mac Catalyst minimum is 17.0 for the .NET 11 toolchain, replacing earlier 11.0 and 13.1 declarations. See https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/maui/supported-platforms and https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/maui/whats-new/dotnet-11.
- The full solution test run fails: Azure tests have four failures because the current production service uses SDK auto-completion while tests expect explicit completion (the production change predates this upgrade); Cosmos tests have two failures where the fake message returns missing for all properties, including the data type used by dispatch. Applets tests do not compile due to a missing AddTextTemplateRenderer extension. Determine intended behavior and repair or update these tests before claiming success.
- The user explicitly excluded out-of-solution project upgrades and approved the Android API minimum increase to 24. Temporary out-of-solution retargeting was undone. ApiCore's excluded test project can still be tested with a transient `-p:TargetFramework=net11.0 -p:TargetFrameworks=net11.0` override; all 24 tests pass. Do not fix ETL, merger or console projects as part of this solution upgrade.
- Updated release notes for the 18 retargeted solution packages and re-ran the IDE solution build successfully. Builds still report existing nullable/obsolete warnings and NU1510; the IDE success does not include all test projects.
- The user believes the test failures predate the upgrade. Treat that as suspected baseline debt, not proof: there is no passing pre-upgrade test baseline. Do not change intentional production behavior or weaken assertions merely to obtain a green run.
- Versioning update (2026-11-20): all 57 explicit version properties across the 19 solution production projects now equal 4.208.110. XML checks passed, and all 15 excluded project files have no working-tree diff. IDE solution build succeeded; compiled Core and ApiCore binaries report AssemblyVersion 4.208.110.0 and FileVersion 4.208.110. Diff whitespace validation passed. This metadata-only change adds no production logic; tests were not rerun and earlier test results remain historical, not post-versioning results.
- Still required for the broader upgrade: review assessment risks and package warnings, resolve or report existing solution test failures without undoing intentional behavior, run final applicable tests, and record a final self-review before completing this task.
